tooling.message:
feat: site-deploy keeps the copies of listed apps; decision dec-copies-served

## Intent

lernapps.net serves a copy of every listed app at lernapps.net/<id>/ (lernapps/docs KD-21, lernapps/apps#58). The apps repo pushes the copies into the root site's gh-pages, so the deploy of the home page must not delete them.

## Key changes

- site-deploy leaves the directories listed in copies.txt ("<id> <commit>" per line) and the file itself alone, as it does pr-preview/.
- arc42: dec-copies-served supersedes dec-app-own-hosting; chapters 3, 5 and 7 follow.
- The skills, the README, the GitHub page and the plan template say an app is published at the creator's address and served as a copy once listed.

## Dependencies and side effects

- lernapps.github.io pins this tooling (490860c) before the apps change (880b129) is merged.

apps.message:
feat: serve a copy of every listed app at lernapps.net/<id>/

## Intent

lernapps.net serves a copy of every listed app, our own included (lernapps/docs KD-21, #58). The copy is built and published when a listing is merged and when an app is updated, at the short address lernapps.net/<id>/.

## Key changes

- Entry format: source (a GitHub repo) and commit (a full id) are required; the seven entries are pinned to the head of their main. Reserved ids: no path of the home page and no other repo of the organisation.
- publish.yml: on a push to main that changes entries, it builds each app at its commit in a container without secrets, checks it, pushes the copy into <id>/ of the root site's gh-pages with the organisation's GitHub App, keeps copies.txt, checks the copy where it is served and builds the catalog again.
- The catalog links an app's copy only when copies.txt lists it at the entry's commit; otherwise it links the entry's url.
- update.yml opens a daily pull request update/<id> for apps whose main moved. It is merged automatically only when nothing but versions of existing npm dependencies changed; otherwise it is labelled review.
- /review reviews the entry's commit by default.
- The texts say the licence must allow the copy and the creator stays the author.
- The plan (.vibe/development-plan-feat-serve-copies.md) records the decisions KD-01 to KD-12, the steps, the GitHub App setup, the rollout and the findings while coding.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Merge only after tooling's site-deploy keeps the copies (7dbcb8a) and lernapps.github.io pins it (490860c), or the next home page deploy deletes the copies.
- Needs the GitHub App in the environment publish, "Allow auto-merge" and a ruleset that requires the listing check.
